h:
对于那些拥有只有 4GB 显卡的笔记本电脑并且仍然想使用 Z-Image Turbo 的人来说，这只是一个非常基本的工作流程。不用说，在如此低的规格下，您将需要使用极其量化的模型和文本编码器。我用的：

文本编码器

- Qwen3-4B-指令-2507-Q4_K_M

(https://huggingface.co/unsloth/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-GGUF/blob/main/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-Q4_K_M.gguf)

GGUF模型

- Z-图像-turbo-q3_k_s

(https://huggingface.co/gguf-org/z-image-gguf/resolve/main/z-image-turbo-q3_k_s.gguf?download=true)

仅使用您可以在常规管理器中找到的节点，没什么花哨的。对于图像到图像，请确保将 WF 中的开关激活为“True”。这是一部弗兰肯斯坦式的 WF，因此感谢其各自的作者。

o.en:
Just a seriously basic workflow for those who have laptops with only 4GB video cards and who still wanna work with Z-Image turbo. Needless to say, with such low specs, you'll need to use extremely quantized models and text encoders. The ones I use:

Text encoders

- Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-Q4_K_M

(https://huggingface.co/unsloth/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-GGUF/blob/main/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-Q4_K_M.gguf)

GGUF Model

- Z-image-turbo-q3_k_s

(https://huggingface.co/gguf-org/z-image-gguf/resolve/main/z-image-turbo-q3_k_s.gguf?download=true)

Only uses nodes you can find in the regular manager, nothing fancy. For image to image, make sure to activate the switch in the WF to "True". This is a frankensteined WF, so credits go to their respective authors.
